question: When will my refund arrive, and how will my coupon discount affect a partial refund?

prediction.transcript: When will my refund arrive, and how will my coupon discount affect a partial refund?
prediction.answer: Your refund will arrive in 1 to 3 business days after it is initiated, as your payment method is UPI. For a partial refund, the refund amount will be the price paid for the returned item after applying any coupon discount. If the remaining order falls below the coupon's minimum order value, the coupon discount on the remaining items will be deducted from the refund.

sources.text:
## [CAN-2] After the order ships
A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can:
- refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or
- accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.
sources.title: After the order ships

sources.text:
## [CPN-3] Returns and coupons
See REF-4 in the Refunds policy.
sources.title: Returns and coupons

sources.text:
## [DEL-1] Delivery times
| Delivery type | Metro cities | Other locations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days |
| Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available |

Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment.
sources.title: Delivery times

sources.text:
## [DEL-2] Delivery fees
Standard delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more; below that a ₹40 fee applies. Express delivery costs ₹79 and is free for ZentroMart Plus members.
sources.title: Delivery fees

sources.text:
## [DEL-3] Delivery attempts
The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies.
sources.title: Delivery attempts

sources.text:
## [KB-00.3] Business days
A business day is Monday to Saturday, excluding the warehouse holidays below. Refund and logistics timelines are counted in business days. Return windows are counted in calendar days.

| Date | Holiday |
| --- | --- |
| 2026-08-15 | Independence Day |
| 2026-10-02 | Gandhi Jayanti |
| 2026-10-19 | Warehouse closure (festival) |
| 2026-11-09 | Warehouse closure (festival) |
sources.title: Business days

sources.text:
## [PLS-2] Benefits
- Free Express delivery where Express is available.
- No reverse pickup fee on any return.
- Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check.

ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.
sources.title: Benefits

sources.text:
## [REF-1] When a refund is initiated
- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.
sources.title: When a refund is initiated

sources.text:
## [REF-2] How long refunds take after initiation
Refunds go back to the original payment method. Timelines are counted in business days from the day the refund is initiated.

| Payment method | Time to reach you |
| --- | --- |
| UPI | 1 to 3 business days |
| Credit or debit card | 5 to 7 business days |
| Net banking | 3 to 5 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet | Instant, within 2 hours |
| Bank transfer (NEFT) for cash-on-delivery orders | 5 to 7 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet for cash-on-delivery orders | Instant, within 2 hours |
sources.title: How long refunds take after initiation

sources.text:
## [REF-3] Cash-on-delivery refunds
For cash-on-delivery orders, the customer chooses either ZentroMart Wallet (instant) or a bank transfer. Bank transfers start only after the bank account details are verified, then take 5 to 7 business days.
sources.title: Cash-on-delivery refunds

sources.text:
## [REF-4] Partial refunds and coupons
If part of an order is returned, the refund is the price paid for that item after its share of any coupon discount. If the remaining order falls below the coupon's minimum order value, the coupon discount on the remaining items is deducted from the refund.
sources.title: Partial refunds and coupons

sources.text:
## [REF-5] Delivery and COD fees
Delivery fees and the ₹25 cash-on-delivery fee are refunded only when the whole order is cancelled before shipping or returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.
sources.title: Delivery and COD fees

sources.text:
## [REF-6] Refund reference number
Every initiated refund has a refund reference number (RRN) that the customer's bank can trace. Share it when a customer says the money has not arrived.
sources.title: Refund reference number

sources.text:
## [RET-7] After pickup
Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy.
sources.title: After pickup
